text.name: ps_rf_pda_side_info
text.text:
Pro Staff Co-Op
This screen is the Pro Staff membership glance for your farm. Each line is one item: membership, then every live modifier the ladder currently applies, then recurring money and the disease flush quote.
Level is your rung on the twenty-step ladder. Invested is what the farm has paid in. Next level shows the price of the next rung; from L10 the price follows net worth, not cash on hand. Next unlock says what that rung adds.
Live means the number is applied right now by Worker Costs, Soil Fertilizer or Dairy. Not applied means the rung is unlocked but nothing pays out yet. Stood down means Precision Farming has taken over soil chemistry; the ladder itself keeps running.
Disease flush quotes the Co-Op treatment of every diseased field you own. Run it here when this door belongs to Pro Staff, otherwise from the Farm Tablet Pro Staff app or the console.
Page with the More and Back buttons or the , and . keys.
